summary: Specifies the MD4 message digest algorithm, designed by Ron Rivest, which turns a message of any length into a short fixed-size fingerprint. It is informational, not a standard, and was replaced by RFC 1320.

eli5.summary: It is a machine that squishes any message into a tiny fingerprint. If the message changes even a little, the fingerprint looks different.

how does md4 message digest work
